title: Spawner Shards
description: Mob spawners drop a shard used to craft new ones and spawn eggs.
body:
## Spawner Shards

Spawner shards is my take on obtaining mob spawners.
Typically people use "silk touch" spawners and for a long time as did I.
But I personally found it to be a little too easy for such a reward.

When mining a mob spawner it will drop 1 shard (1-4 with fortune)
8 shards to craft a mob spawner
using 1 shard and  a varity of mob drops will craft a spawn egg. Using the spawn egg on any mob spawner will change it to that mob.
